findings.title: Concurrent identical marketplace enquiries can persist duplicate negotiations before the idempotency receipt fails.
findings.scenario: Sara sends an enquiry to Tom's listing twice at the same instant. Both requests see no prior idempotency receipt and create separate exchanges, after which the second hits a unique receipt constraint and returns an error. Tom can receive two negotiations for one enquiry.
findings.test_needed: Concurrently submit identical enquiry UUIDs using PostgreSQL and verify exactly one exchange and one receipt, with repeat-safe response.

owner_question.question: What should happen if Sara accidentally submits her marketplace enquiry to Tom twice simultaneously?
options: Create one negotiation and replay its outcome
Create one negotiation and safely reject the duplicate
Create two negotiations with a server error (current race)

findings.title: Revoked invitation sender continues receiving membership response notifications containing staff identities.
findings.scenario: Lina invites Sara to Tom's pharmacy but subsequently loses her organisation membership and staff-management authority. When Sara responds or leaves, Lina remains a notification recipient through the original inviter link and receives Sara's name and email.
findings.test_needed: After revoking Lina's organisation/pharmacy authority, make Sara accept/leave. Lina receives no email or in-app notification; valid managers still receive it.

owner_question.question: Should former manager Lina continue receiving Sara's membership notifications after her access is revoked?
options: No, recheck recipient authority for each event
Yes, retain all inviter notifications after removal
